tooltip-recipes-only: Only show pages where the item can be crafted in the grid
tooltip-original-search: Disable all Enhanced Handbook search functions
tooltip-create-category:
Hold CTRL to delete the currently selected category
Hold SHIFT to rename the currently selected category
tooltip-search-prefixes:
+term: Require this word
!term: Exclude matches containing the word
=code: Exact handbook page code
%code: Match handbook page code or name (%% for exact)
?term: Match page description words, similar to orig. search
#name: Create or Update a category by adding terms separated by spaces
guide-text:
Enhanced Handbook useful tips

If you need additional help or just want to say hi, join us in the discord channel Interzone VS Mods!

Categories
- If you enter the same name as a already present category you will add to it
- Hold shift or ctrl to either rename or delete the selected category
- You can drag and drop items to and from categories

Groups
- If you shift click a page in any tab it will create a Group, a kind of category within a category
- When shift clicking, the mod will try to add similar items to the Group but it can take a few clicks
- Use the same Group name when shift clicking to add to it, the last one created is pre-filled
- Click a Group to open it, shift click a Group to delete it and free all the items within :)
- Drag and drop items to a Group to add them, and drag them out of the Group to remove them
- The "Everything (Grouped)" category contains already made groups for all variants (same item with different materials).
